description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans SiloBuilder, including implementations of test classes, configuration validation, and various test cases verifying the correct setup and error handling of silo configurations without requiring a full Orleans cluster.

classes.name: NoOpMembershipTable
classes.description: A mock implementation of IMembershipTable used for testing silo configuration without actual membership infrastructure.

classes.name: SiloBuilderTests
classes.description: Contains multiple unit tests verifying Orleans silo configuration, validation, and startup behavior.

methods.name: SiloBuilderTest
methods.description: Verifies that a silo can be successfully built with localhost clustering and required options.

methods.name: SiloBuilder_GrainCollectionOptionsForZeroSecondsAgeLimitTest
methods.description: Ensures that GrainCollectionOptions with a zero second collection age limit throw an OrleansConfigurationException.

methods.name: SiloBuilder_ClusterMembershipOptionsValidators
methods.description: Validates that ClusterMembershipOptions have correct relationship between NumVotesForDeathDeclaration and NumProbedSilos.

methods.name: SiloBuilder_LoadSheddingValidatorAbove100ShouldFail
methods.description: Ensures LoadSheddingOptions with CpuThreshold > 100 throw an OrleansConfigurationException.

methods.name: SiloBuilderThrowsDuringStartupIfNoGrainsAdded
methods.description: Confirms that starting a silo with no registered grain classes or interfaces throws an OrleansConfigurationException.

methods.name: SiloBuilderThrowsDuringStartupIfClientBuildersAdded
methods.description: Ensures configuring both a client and silo in the same host throws an OrleansConfigurationException.

methods.name: SiloBuilderWithHotApplicationBuilderThrowsDuringStartupIfClientBuildersAdded
methods.description: Verifies the same client-silo configuration restriction when using Host.CreateApplicationBuilder.
